visualRisks.description: Waterfront district has a large empty space that might look uninteresting or incomplete.
visualRisks.suggestion: Add more detailed elements like docks, houses, or other structures to fill the empty spaces.

visualRisks.description: The route crosses through areas with no visible roads or paths, which may confuse players.
visualRisks.suggestion: Ensure that all parts of the route are clearly marked as roads and connect logically between points.

navigationRisks.description: The route includes a jump from row 15 to row 40 without intermediate steps, which could be disorienting.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Smooth out the route by adding more stepping stones or intermediate points between large jumps.

navigationRisks.description: There are repeated rows (e.g., '...rr_...~..' and '....r_......') that might indicate a design flaw or placeholder text.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Review and clean up the district layout to remove any redundant or unintended patterns.
